text:
maya: Kickoff: PHX (us-phx) rollout. Goal: bring minimal serving capacity + routing by EOW. Quick ownership check and blockers?
sam: I can own routing policy + DNS. Will need the exact prefix list and failover plan.
maya: thx @sam. prefix tag: region=us-phx. Failover target: us-west-2 primary, us-south fallback. Can you confirm?
sam: Confirmed. Will open PR for route policies and a smoke test script. PR soon (will tag infra).
leo: I'll own infra capacity — aiming for 4x A10G initially, can scale. Need quota increase in phx cloud account.
anya: I have a KMS/keys question — are we creating a dedicated key alias/redwood-phx? Also backup residency: no cross-region snapshots per compliance.
julian: Security: yes to dedicated key. I'll file the KMS request (ticket INF-2739).
maya: @leo pls open infra PR with tf changes and add a `canary=true` label so router can pick it up.
sam: Quick note: router requires a policy with priority and cost tiers. Example:
`{
 "match": {"region": "us-phx"},
 "priority": 220,
 "fallback": "us-west-2"
}`
I will include this in PR.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist generated: networks, kms, iam, dns, capacity, smoke-tests.
maya: CR pings: @sam PR #4042, @leo PR #4047, @julian security docs PR #4050. Please request reviews from eng-sre and eng-security.
leo: PR created: #4047 — includes tf for gp2, subnet, boltdb routing tag. Need quick review from infra.
sam: PR draft #4042 posted with route policy + smoke script. Needs product approval on latency SLO.
anya: Product: what's the SLO we commit for PHX? Users in AZ/CA currently at 40-60ms.
maya: Product (cc @ben) wants 50ms p95 for gen API. If can't meet, we'll mark as best-effort for first week.
ben: I'll accept 50ms p95 as target for GA. For canary we'll do best-effort.
maya: Dependencies list to track: KMS ticket INF-2739, Quota ticket CLOUD-621, PRs #4042 #4047 #4050. Can we add ETA next to each?
sam: ETA for route policy PR review: 24h.
leo: Quota ticket submitted, ETA 48h.
julian: KMS ticket in 6-12h.
maya: great. if anything slips, call it out here and we'll pull from next sprint. thanks all :thumbsup:
